title: Unleashing Hour-Scale Video Training for Long Video-Language Understanding

layout.note: A full-width taxonomy tree on top, its caption centred under it, and a row of four statistics panels below (two donut charts and two histograms), each captioned with a letter and a title underneath.

lesson: Summarise a dataset in one figure: a taxonomy tree with tall rotated-text leaves and one coloured tag per leaf for a binary attribute, above a row of small statistics charts (donuts for composition, histograms for durations and counts), each lettered and titled.
